info.name: RLOE — Interview Demo Pack
info.description:
Enterprise-grade Postman collection for live interview demonstration of the Revenue Lifecycle Orchestration Engine (RLOE).

Architectural Highlights:
- Async Inbound Gate with Ingestion Latency < 1500ms
- Deterministic Pre-Filtering Gate (Sub-10ms) saving 80%+ LLM token costs
- NVIDIA Nemotron (nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b) structured routing
- Clay Waterfall Enrichment with resilient fallback handling
- Supabase Inbound Intent Log & Telemetry persistence
- HubSpot CRM automated Deal and Task generation
- Unique constraint caching preventing duplicate enrichment and LLM spend
